@topic acc-adjustments

Q: An asset costs ₦400,000, has a scrap value of ₦10,000 and a useful life of 10 years. Find the yearly straight-line depreciation.
A: ₦39,000
W: ₦40,000
W: ₦41,000
W: ₦390,000
E: Depreciation = (cost − scrap value) ÷ life = (₦400,000 − ₦10,000) ÷ 10 = ₦39,000.

@topic acc-partnership

Q: Tunde and Amaka share profits in the ratio 2:3. The profit for the year is ₦195,000. What is Amaka's share?
A: ₦117,000
W: ₦78,000
W: ₦97,500
W: ₦292,500
E: Amaka's share = 3/5 × ₦195,000 = ₦117,000.
